g.text: Source-only exposure filtering recovers the target graph

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Frozen filtered-model noninferiority: supported. Exact target energy identity with the supplied N15 oracle.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 5,180 unique N14 source patterns · 4,096 fresh N15 search inputs · fixed threshold ln(364 / 0.01)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: The filter removes four spurious offsets. Two removed diagonal entries remain enforced by the unchanged lines.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Six of 60 finite zero offsets fall below threshold; all four true knight offsets remain. The final graph has no false or missed attacks.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: The supplied-oracle bar is mapped from exact pre-inference identity; six distinct searches ran, and three duplicate jobs were avoided.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Exposure is N × sum of products of source cell marginals over valid placements. No radius cutoff or target-label tuning is used.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: The independence model is a heuristic: its threshold is not a calibrated p-value, coverage claim or Bonferroni guarantee for constrained data.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: The rule was frozen before exposure scores were computed. The target universe was already enumerated and structurally censused;

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: fresh means disjoint from earlier search cohorts. Original and certificate-first scores remain separate in the tracked tables.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: One complete unique-pattern source universe; three repeated search seeds do not establish reliability across source draws or data multiplicities.
